title: A request can race the Engram control worker's idle exit and fail as control_unavailable although it was never sent
outcome: ProcessEngramControlTransport::process_for (src/engram_control_transport.rs:100-149 at d1d92bbb) returns a cached process when worker_finished is false. The worker's idle recv_timeout can then exit (about :355-357) before request() hands it the request (:194-206), so the request fails as 'control worker is unavailable' or a disconnected reply (:219) during an ordinary idle reap. A request that provably never reached the Engram process is retried once on a fresh process, or reported as a definite not-sent error that is never mistaken for an uncertain exchange. A possibly-written request is never replayed blindly. A deterministic test pins the boundary between the worker deciding to exit and the request hand-off; the existing idle-reap test waits for completed termination and misses it.
acceptance: A request can race the Engram control worker's idle exit and fail as control_unavailable although it was never sent is done
